item.title: HF_DATASETS_CACHE on WSL2: Where the Other Files Go
item.description: Measured Hub downloads, Arrow files, import order, saved datasets, and cleanup on WSL2. Why HF_DATASETS_CACHE and cache_dir leave other files behind.

item.title: Fix WSL2 Resize Error Wsl/Service/0xc03a001a (2.7.3)
item.description: On WSL 2.7.3, compressed and sparse VHDX files booted but --resize failed with 0xc03a001a; clearing the attribute restored 9/9 retries.

item.title: Hugging Face Cache on WSL2: HF_HOME, /mnt/c, and Cleanup
item.description: I tested HF_HOME, HF_HUB_CACHE, symlinks, and /mnt/c on WSL2, then measured cleanup behavior with the current hf cache commands.

item.title: Shrink WSL2 ext4.vhdx in 2026: Sparse VHD vs diskpart, Measured
item.description: Deleted 20 GB inside WSL but ext4.vhdx stayed huge? Measured on WSL 2.7.3: fstrim no longer needed, sparse VHD gated as unsafe, diskpart rejects sparse files.
